# notes2cards

> notes2cards is an AI-powered Anki flashcard generator that turns any study material into ready-to-import Anki decks (.apkg) in seconds.

## Overview
notes2cards uses Google Gemini AI to convert PDFs, PowerPoints, images, and text notes into high-quality Anki flashcards with support for Q&A cards and cloze deletions. It is used by 10,000+ students worldwide including medical, law, STEM, language learners, and certification candidates.

## Core Features
- Upload PDFs (up to 80 pages), PowerPoints, or images
- AI-generated Anki flashcards with Q&A and cloze deletion support
- Direct .apkg export — import straight into Anki desktop or AnkiDroid
- Smart image extraction from documents
- Sub-deck organization for structured study
- Spaced repetition optimized card generation
- Free tier available (5 pages/month, 5-page file limit)

## Pricing
- **Free Plan**: $0/month — 5 pages/month, 5-page file limit, 5 generations/day
- **Pro Monthly**: $5/month — 600 pages/month, 60-page files, unlimited generations
- **Pro Yearly**: $32/year — Same as Pro Monthly, save ~46%
- **Lifetime**: $69.99 one-time — 800 pages/month, 80-page files, yours forever
- Regional pricing available for India, developing markets, and frontier economies

## Target Users
- Medical students (anatomy, pharmacology, pathology)
- Law students (case briefs, statutes)
- STEM students (formulas, definitions, concepts)
- Language learners (vocabulary, grammar)
- Certification candidates (AWS, CPA, bar exam)
- Anyone who uses Anki for spaced repetition study

## Privacy & Data Handling
- Files uploaded by users are deleted immediately after deck generation
- No user data is used for model training
- Generation logs (token counts and metadata only) retained for quota calibration
- GDPR compliant — users can request data deletion via contact page
- All connections encrypted via HTTPS
